sections.heading: What Is ATH Recruiters?
paragraphs: ATH Recruiters, also widely known as Abuja Talent Hub, is the official staffing brand of Traction Outsourcing Limited and one of the recruitment agencies in Abuja serving businesses across Nigeria. This is the official website for both ATH Recruiters and Abuja Talent Hub. We were built to solve one specific problem: getting Nigerian businesses and homes the right person, fast, and affordably. We maintain a verified community of ready-to-work candidates, from entry-level graduates to experienced professionals, so that when you need staff, you are not starting from zero, you are choosing from people who are already screened and available.
Find & Review Us on Google

sections.heading: Our Recruitment Plans
sections.sub: Three ways to work with us, depending on how often you hire and what kind of role you are filling.

entries.title: Plan A — High-Volume Staffing
entries.text:
Tailored search and selection services designed to fill core operational roles with precision. This tier provides direct access to our verified community professionals, ensuring cultural fit and technical competence.

Ideal for roles with high attrition rates or rapid scaling needs in industries like Sales, Hospitality, Construction, FinTechs, Technology, Industries, FMCG, ad-hoc staffing, homes, private staff, and more.

✓ Unlimited candidate requests
✓ First time waiting period of 1 month
✓ Best for roles with high attrition rates
✓ Just 24-48 hours waiting period during subscription
✓ Available in all states in Nigeria

entries.title: Plan B — Specialized Talent Search
entries.text:
A highly strategic, comprehensive recruitment service dedicated to sourcing specialized talent and leadership roles across various Nigerian states and international markets.

Best for companies that usually need one staff member at a time, with a very low attrition rate.

✓ Candidate sourcing
✓ Candidate selection
✓ Pre-interview advisory
✓ Save time wasted on vacancy ads
✓ Save time wasted on sourcing through CVs
✓ Save time wasted on pre-interview screening
✓ One-off service
✓ Qualified candidates in 2 weeks or less
✓ Available in all states in Nigeria

entries.title: Plan C — End-to-End Executive HR Partnership
entries.text:
A fully managed, consultant-led recruitment process from initial sourcing through to corporate integration.

Best for organizations seeking a complete corporate onboarding experience, expert interview panels, and post-hire development.

✓ First-level interviewing with a Traction Outsourcing HR professional
✓ Second-level joint panel interviews with Traction Outsourcing HR professional and your management
✓ Full HR compliance support, including standardized staff offer letters, tailored job descriptions, and optional staff background check
✓ Includes 2 standardized trainings delivered by our management consultants (1 general staff training and 1 corporate onboarding training)
✓ Minimum of 5 recruited staff for this plan

entries.title: Home Plan — Home Recruitment
entries.text:
Specially designed for homeowners who need to recruit domestic staff once, without ongoing management. We find the right person, hand them over, and you take full control from there.

Best for homeowners recruiting domestic staff: nannies, cooks, cleaners, drivers, gardeners, security, and other home-based roles.

✓ One-off recruitment service
✓ Candidate sourcing from verified community
✓ Skills and background screening
✓ Hands-off after placement, you manage your own home staff
✓ Free one-time replacement within the first month
✓ Single, one-time fee. No recurring charges
✓ No staff management included
✓ Available across Nigeria

entries.q: Is ATH Recruiters the same as Abuja Talent Hub?
entries.a: Yes. ATH Recruiters is the official recruitment brand also known as Abuja Talent Hub, operated by Traction Outsourcing Limited. Both names refer to the same verified community of ready-to-work candidates and the same recruitment service.

entries.q: Is ATH Recruiters an affordable recruitment agency in Nigeria?
entries.a: Yes. ATH Recruiters is built to be one of the more affordable recruitment agencies in Nigeria, with plans starting from ₦30,000 for select roles, keeping pricing accessible for small businesses and private individuals, not just large corporations.

entries.q: Is ATH Recruiters a domestic staff recruitment agency in Nigeria?
entries.a: Yes. ATH Recruiters works as a domestic staff recruitment agency in Abuja and across Nigeria, placing housekeepers, cooks, drivers, nannies, and other personal staff for private homes and individuals who need people they can trust.

entries.q: How fast can ATH Recruiters fill a role?
entries.a: Turnaround depends on the plan. Plan A offers a 24 to 48 hour turnaround for subscribers, Plan B typically delivers qualified candidates within 2 weeks for specialised roles, and Plan C is a fully managed process suited to leadership and bulk hires.
